name: Settler
role: Ranch hands and homesteaders in from their claims
about: Sun-worn working people, slow to talk and slower to trust. Talk about land, weather and stock.

say: Prices in this town would make a mule weep.
You ain't from the cattle company, are you?
There's claims for sale out past the homesteads,
if you got the money and the nerve.
Somebody's been riding off with good horses.
Thoroughbreds, mostly. Dry Creek, I'd wager.
The Lantern Men burn out whoever won't pay.
Saw the smoke from my porch last week.
but a draft won't outrun nothing.
Take what you want, just leave me be!
